cues.text: 自動化の設定を、ファイルにして持ち運びます。
時刻が抜けていると、読み込みで止まります。
時刻をひとつ戻すと、形式の点検を通って保存できます。
ただし、時刻が正しいか、実際に動くかは、別の確認です。
参照先がふたつあっても、保存されるのは先頭だけ。元の設定と見比べましょう。

scenes.label: 設定を、持ち運ぶ
scenes.action: One configuration file, format inspection gate, output file. Same physical objects stay throughout.

scenes.label: 時刻がないと、止まる
scenes.action: The clock piece is visibly absent. This input file stops at the same inspection gate. No saved output appears.

scenes.label: 時刻を戻して、保存
scenes.action: Add only the schedule clock piece to the same O03 file, corresponding to frozen O04. The gate passes it and the real export file moves to a save/device icon.

scenes.label: 形式と、実行は別
scenes.action: The format gate accepts a filled but invalid cron string. A question-mark clock remains, visibly separating file shape from actual scheduling. Do not show actual scheduler execution.

scenes.label: 参照先は、先頭だけ
scenes.action: Two folder/reference pieces enter with input; only the first accompanies the serialized file. The second remains outside the export. Compare actual saved data.

scenes.label: 図で確かめ、設定を保存
scenes.action: Hold the complete file-gate-output relationship and point to the real downloadable O04 file for at least three seconds. No blank ending.

mix: Five real Irodori TTS segments placed without overlap or edits, padded with silence. No music or effects. MP4 renderer normalizes loudness and encodes AAC.
voice_reference: Own caption-generated synthetic voice; no real-person recording.
